data.name: Amsah
data.long_meaning: Amsah is derived from the Arabic root word 'Ams' which means 'to support, carry, or help'. This name is given to a boy signifying that he is a warrior of the righteous, one who supports and helps those in need. In the Islamic tradition, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is described as an 'Ams' for the believers, supporting and guiding them towards the right path.
